core_obligations: Reduce (1) to the divisors separation lemma via the product ideal and finite-presentation bookkeeping
Check the admissibility of the composite blowup and strict-transform compatibility
Prove (2) by cutting constructible sets with extendable finite-type ideals

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce (1) to the divisors separation lemma via the product ideal and finite-presentation bookkeeping
Check the admissibility of the composite blowup and strict-transform compatibility
Prove (2) by cutting constructible sets with extendable finite-type ideals

difficulty_reason: (1) Z_i of finite presentation have finitely generated ideal sheaves; form Z cut by I_1 I_2 so Z ∩ U = (Z_1 ∩ U) amalga (Z_2 ∩ U), apply the Divisors-on-Spaces separation lemma to get a U ∩ Z-admissible blowup Z' -> Z with disjoint strict transforms; its center Y -> X is a finite-presentation closed immersion, so blowing up Y in X is U-admissible, and strict transforms agree under the composite blowup by the strict-transform compatibility lemma. (2) cut the constructible T_i by finite-type ideals on U (limits lemma), extend the ideals to X (extend lemma), apply (1).
